claims.statement: The function export_database exists in admin/backup.py
Function export_database is located in admin/backup.py around line 25
Function export_database opens the sqlite database app.db
Function export_database dumps all tables using iterdump()
Function export_database saves the dump result under public/backups/<date>.sql
Files saved under public/backups/<date>.sql have no access control
The admin/backup.py module is imported at startup
The export runs on a timer so fresh dumps appear daily
The backup directory is served by the same static download path as other public files
Against demo-v1, listing the backup directory and downloading the latest dump exposes all user emails and password hashes without authentication
